stem.text: The diagram shows the Boltzmann energy distribution curves for molecules of a sample of a gas at two different temperatures.
Which letter on the axes represents the most probable energy for molecules of the same sample of gas at the **lower** temperature?

stem.alt: Boltzmann energy distribution: two curves of fraction of molecules against energy. Labels A and B on the vertical axis mark the peak heights; labels C and D on the horizontal axis mark the peak energies. The taller, narrower curve peaks at A and C; the lower, broader curve peaks at B and D.
